shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: The Khalsa way of life (code of conduct).
There is one Lord Creator; victory be to the Lord.
Verbal Declaration of the Tenth Sovereign.
Soratha.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਰਹਿਤ ਯਹ ਜਾਨ ਖੰਡੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਹੁਲ ਛਕੇ॥
verses.translit_en: pratham rahit yeh jaan kha(n)dde kee paahul chhake||

en.bdb: Know that the first injunction of the Rehit is to undertake the Amrit of the two-edged sword.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਿੰਘ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਹੁਲ ਜੋ ਲਏ॥੧॥
verses.translit_en: soiee si(n)gh pradhaan avar na paahul jo le||1||

en.bdb: Such a Singh is superior who takes Amrit of no other kind.
The Amrit which the five Singhs give;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਸਿਰ ਧਰ ਛਕ ਪੁਨ ਲੇਵੈ॥੨॥
verses.translit_en: taa(n) ko sir dhar chhak pun levai||2||

en.bdb: He should bow his head and receive it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਨ ਮਿਲ ਪਾਂਚਹੁ ਰਹਿਤ ਜੋ ਭਾਖਹਿਂ॥
verses.translit_en: pun mil paa(n)chahu rahit jo bhaakhahi(n)||

en.bdb: Then the Rehit which the five Singhs deliver;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਮਨ ਮੈਂ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਕਰ ਰਾਖਹਿ॥੩॥
verses.translit_en: taa(n) ko man mai(n) dhiraR kar raakhah||3||

en.bdb: He should fix it within his heart.
Those who kill their daughters and commit other such evil deeds;
Keep well away from them, renounce them.
Every day show your love for the Guru's Bani.
Renounce backbiting slandering, and the property of other's.
The first commands of the Rehit are those;
Which the Singhs have prescribed to you in the Pahul ceremony.

verses.gurmukhi: ਔਰ ਜੁ ਰਹਤ ਕਹੀ ਹੈ ਨਾਨ੍ਹਾ॥
verses.translit_en: aauar ju rahat kahee hai naanhaa||

en.bdb: The other injunctions of the Rehit;
I say before you so you may explain to other Singhs.
Every day utter Waheguru.
Imbue the mantra of Waheguru in your heart.
When a Singh comes across you;
Greet him with *Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh*.
Arise at the last quarter of night and take a bath.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਨ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੁ ਉਚਰੈ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: pun mukh te jap jaap ucharai||10||

en.bdb: Then recite your morning prayers such as JapJi and Jaap.
Give to charity as your resources permit;
Such a Singh is supremely Wise.
Naam, charity and bathing at morning hours;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤਿਨਹੁ ਇਹ ਜਾਨਾ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit_en: jin gur kirapaa tinahu ieh jaanaa||12||

en.bdb: Are known and practiced by those whom the Guru has been gracious to.
Profit which you have made with the ten nails of your hands (honest earnings);

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਕਰ ਜੋ ਧਨ ਘਰ ਮੈ ਆਵੈ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: taa(n) kar jo dhan ghar mai aavai||13||

en.bdb: Sustain your household only with such an income.
The Singh who donates a tenth of his income to the Guru;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਘ ਸੁ ਜਸ ਬਹੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਈ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: si(n)gh su jas bahu jag meh leiee||14||

en.bdb: shall be greatly honored in this world.
Consider another's daughter as your own daughter;
Consider another's wife as your own mother.
One who remains loyal to his own wife;
Is a Rehitvant (one who is dedicated to the Rehit) Singh.
Lust, anger, pride, intoxication, and greed;

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਵੈਰੀ ਕਰ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਛੋਭਾ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: eeh vairee kar hai man chhobhaa||17||

en.bdb: These are the enemies which afflict the heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਕੋ ਹਠ ਕਰ ਜੀਵਤ ਕਰੈ॥
verses.translit_en: ein ko haTh kar jeevat karai||

en.bdb: One who resists them begins to truly live life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਯਾ ਧਰਮ ਤਪ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਧਰੈ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: dhayaa dharam tap so man dharai||18||

en.bdb: Keep within your heart Compassion, righteousness, and austerity.
Never be separated from your Kachera and Kirpan.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਲਰੈ ਨ ਰਣ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੈ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: sanamukh larai na ran te bhaagai||19||

en.bdb: Fight the enemy directly, never turn your back and flee from the battlefield.
When reciting Ardas bow your head.
Meditate upon the supreme Guru within your heart.
Wherever you happen to find a Khalsa;
Greet him with *Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh*.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਤ ਜੋ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਕਰ ਹੈ॥
verses.translit_en: prem sahat jo dharashan kar hai||

en.bdb: One who comes for Darshan with love;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਪੁਨ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹਿ ਪਰ ਹੈ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit_en: te pun bhav saagar neh par hai||22||

en.bdb: Will not have to cross over the World-ocean again.
One who does not bow before a Turk (Mughal).
Such a Singh is called Rehatvant (one obedient to the Rehat).
Do not become a servant of the Turks (ruling Mughals).
No one shall greet with the Salaam (salutations) of the Turks.
Do not trust the Turks.
Have no friendly dealings with them.
Be the servant of the Khalsa solely;
Meeting whom one finds much bliss.
Having Darshan of whom obliterates sins.
With content hearts they know no worries.
The very image of the Guru is the Khalsa;
From whose service celestial peace is obtained.
